description.en: Modernisation and partial realignment of Serbian mainline 106 from Niš to the Bulgarian border at Dimitrovgrad, the Serbian leg of the Corridor X branch toward Sofia. Under construction with European Investment Bank and EU support. No construction-start or opening date could be sourced, so the lot carries none; sources disagree on the total, with EUR 502 million given as the project cost against EUR 268–276 million quoted for individual subprojects.

amount.note: Proposed finance, as reported by the EIB.

detail.en: European Investment Bank, proposed finance of about EUR 341 million.

note.en: Pirot Plus Online (22 July 2026) reports a completion deadline of the end of 2027 for the project's four components. This is a press report of a works deadline, not an official opening date.
note.ro: Pirot Plus Online (22 iulie 2026) indică drept termen de finalizare a celor patru componente ale proiectului sfârșitul anului 2027. Este un termen de execuție raportat de presă, nu o dată oficială de deschidere.
